title: DTN: expiry comparison wraparound inconsistency between route gate and dtn_expire
description: Review finding from b7z9.8.2.2 (pass 3). router.c:701 route gate uses unsigned expiry > now (breaks at uint32 wrap, year 2106); lichen_router_dtn_expire (router.c:1277) uses wrap-safe signed diff (int32_t)(expiry - now) <= 0. Unify on the signed wrap-safe form for the route gate as well.
close_reason: Fixed in 56cd8a3424: the DTN route gate in lichen_router_route_packet now uses the wrap-safe signed form (int32_t)(expiry - now) > 0 — exactly matching lichen_router_dtn_expire's existing semantics (bead goal: unify). Fail-open now_unix==0 branch unchanged. New routing_dispatch test case 10 covers the uint32 wrap (now=UINT32_MAX-10, expiry=5 -> STORE; the old unsigned comparison dropped it) with a fresh-router setup to avoid slot-accounting interference. Suite passes (gcc-14, ASan/UBSan, -Werror). Reviews: 3 passes on kimi-k3, all PASS — pass 1 confirmed equivalence for non-wrap values and flagged a pre-existing dtn.c legacy-buffer nit (filed as a follow-up bead); pass 2 confirmed the signed form NARROWS the attacker-settable far-future expiry window; pass 3 confirmed test isolation and the expiry==now boundary.
